hero.headline: Don't Let Time Decide the Value of Your Harvest.
hero.subheadline: FreshRoute AI predicts post-harvest value loss, matches direct bulk buyers, and recommends the highest net profit action for every batch.

howItWorks.title: From Harvest to Maximum Realized Value
howItWorks.subtitle: A complete 6-stage algorithmic optimization pipeline preventing distress sales.
howItWorks.step1_desc: Log batch weight, variety, location, and harvesting conditions.
howItWorks.step2_desc: Computer vision models score firmness, skin defects, and brix ripeness.
howItWorks.step3_desc: Bio-thermal decay models project hourly quality degradation curves.
howItWorks.step4_desc: Evaluate transport vehicle rates, cooling dynamics, and buyer offers.
howItWorks.step5_desc: Multi-criteria optimizer ranks Sell, Wait, Reroute, Process, or Store.
howItWorks.step6_desc: Direct booking with guaranteed dispatch, escrow payment, and telemetry.

fiveActions.title: The Five Strategic Post-Harvest Actions
fiveActions.subtitle: Never settle for distress selling at the nearest gate. Optimize for maximum net returns.
fiveActions.sell_desc: Lock in peak freshness pricing with immediate local quick-commerce dispatch.
fiveActions.reroute_desc: Transport to high-demand metropolitan wholesale hubs when prices justify transit costs.
fiveActions.process_desc: Divert grade-B or cosmetic defect produce to pulping, puree, and ketchup plants.
fiveActions.store_desc: Buffer supply in solar micro-cold rooms to capture future price spikes.
fiveActions.donate_desc: Direct food bank donation for zero waste, tax rebate, and social welfare credits.
